PLAN "12-Week fat loss & glycemic control program with nutrition guidance"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Fat loss and glycemic control while preserving lean mass"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full-body conditioning intro":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x15 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 60 seconds
          hip_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Full-body conditioning progression":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          incline_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bent_over_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          step_up 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_curl 3x12 rpe 7 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 2" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progressive overload + conditioning":
        warmup:
          jogging 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x4..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_row 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          cable_fly 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          seated_row 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 60 seconds
          pec_stretch 60 seconds
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Progression & volume":
        warmup:
          cycling 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 3x5..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_extension 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          face_pull 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 60 seconds
          back_stretch 60 seconds
  PHASE "Phase 3" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Glycemic-focused conditioning":
        warmup:
          walking 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          lat_pulldown 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          oblique_circuit 2 rounds:
            russian_twist 2x12..20 rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
            side_plank 2x30 seconds per side
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 5 minutes
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Maintain strength, increase work capacity":
        warmup:
          rowing 5 minutes
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          bench_press 3x6..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          pull_up 3x4..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          dumbbell_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          hip_thrust 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility sequence 5 minutes

NUTRITION GUIDANCE (diabetes-focused, practical)
- Calorie target: aim for 500 kcal/day deficit from maintenance to support fat loss, reassessed every 2–4 weeks. Use bodyweight-based estimates and adjust for activity.
- Macronutrient distribution:
  - Protein: 1.6–2.2 g/kg body weight per day to preserve lean mass and support glycemic control.
  - Carbohydrates: 2.5–3.5 g/kg body weight per day, with emphasis on high-fiber, low-glycemic sources.
  - Fat: remaining calories from fats, prioritizing unsaturated fats.
- Meal timing and structure:
  - 3 main meals with 1–2 balanced snacks as needed to avoid large postprandial glucose spikes.
  - Distribute carbohydrate intake evenly across meals; include protein with each meal.
  - Post-workout: include protein and some carbs to aid recovery and insulin response.
- Glycemic targets and monitoring:
  - HbA1c target: consider aiming for <7.0% with medical guidance; monitor fasting glucose and postprandial responses.
  - Pre-prandial glucose: 80–130 mg/dL; postprandial 1–2 hour <180 mg/dL as practical targets.
  - If new to glucose monitoring, start with 2–3 fingerstick measurements daily around meals; adjust with clinician input.
- Metformin considerations:
  - Take with meals to reduce GI side effects; stay hydrated.
  - Be aware of potential GI symptoms; adjust fiber and meal timing if needed.
- Nutrition strategy for fat loss and glycemic control:
  - Prioritize fiber-rich vegetables, whole fruits (in moderation), lean proteins, legumes, whole grains.
  - Choose low-glycemic index carbohydrate sources (oats, quinoa, whole grain bread, beans).
  - Limit refined sugars and highly processed foods; monitor portion sizes.
  - Include a protein source with every snack to help satiety and glycemic response.
  - Hydration: aim for at least 2.0–2.5 liters daily, more with exercise.
- Supplement considerations (consult with clinician):
  - Vitamin D and a general multivitamin as needed.
  - Omega-3 fats from fish or algae sources if dietary intake is low.
- Safety and contraindications:
  - Start with moderate-intensity workouts; avoid high-impact or plyometrics if joints are sensitive.
  - Screen for neuropathy, retinopathy, or nephropathy with clinician guidance; adjust based on symptoms.
  - Ensure warmups and cooldowns are consistent to reduce injury risk.
- Progression and adjustments:
  - Reassess body weight, waist measurement, and performance every 4 weeks.
  - If weight loss stalls or energy flags, consider minor calorie reduction (150–250 kcal) and/or increased NEAT activity.

ADDITIONAL PROGRAM NOTES
- Session structure stability: every week follows a similar template to support adherence and glycemic control.
- Full gym environment signifies access to machines, free weights, and cables; use canonical exercises listed in the vocabulary.
- Prioritize technique and ROM, especially as volume increases in Phase 2 and Phase 3.
- Conditioning emphasis: include 1–2 additional cardio sessions per week (walking, cycling, or rowing) 20–40 minutes at moderate intensity, gradually increasing duration or pace as tolerated.
